test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recent developments of the ***National Legal Services Authority*** (NALSA):

1. Justice Surya Kant has been appointed as the Executive Chairman of NALSA in May 2025.

2. The Veer Parivaar Sahayata Yojana is dedicated to providing free legal assistance to the Indian Army personnel families across India.

Which of the above statements is/are ***correct***?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Justice Surya Kant**, a Judge of the Supreme Court of India, was **appointed **as the **Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority** (NALSA) effective May 14, 2025.
 
• **He succeeded Justice B. R. Gavai**, following the convention that the second senior-most judge of the Supreme Court holds this post.
 
• As Executive Chairman, Justice Surya Kant leads NALSA's mission to provide free and accessible legal aid to marginalized and economically weaker sections of society across India.
 
 
• Hence, **statement 1 is *CORRECT*.**
 
 
 
• The **Veer Parivaar Sahayata Yojana, launched in 2025 by the National Legal Services Authority** (NALSA), is a pioneering n**ationwide legal aid initiative dedicated to serving the families of active-duty soldiers, veterans, and paramilitary personnel across India**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide these families with free, timely, and professional legal assistance that addresses their unique service-related circumstances and challenges.
 
• This scheme provides such assistance **not only to the family of the Indian Armed Forces** (Indian Army, Air Force and Navy), **but also to those of the Indian Paramilitary forces, Central Armed Police Forces**, etc.
 
 
• Hence, **statement 2 is *INCORRECT*.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Legal Services Authority (NALSA):** Established under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, NALSA aims to provide free legal services to the weaker sections of society and to organize Lok Adalats for amicable settlement of disputes.
 
• **Legal Aid:** Legal aid is provided to marginalized groups, including women, children, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and persons in custody, to ensure equality before the law as per Article 39A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• **Lok Adalats:** Lok Adalats, organized under NALSA, are a system of alternative dispute resolution to expedite the resolution of cases outside formal court proceedings.
 
• **Free Legal Services:** Beneficiaries of free legal services under NALSA include women, children, differently-abled persons, Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes, and others as specified in Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
 
• **Recent Initiatives by NALSA:** The "Tele-Law" service, in collaboration with Common Service Centres (CSCs), aims to provide legal advice to citizens in rural and remote areas through video conferencing and telephone services.
